Kid-Decided Lunch, Zero Regrets 🍔🍟
Jan 2026 • Family
Some days the itinerary is carefully planned.
Other days… it’s decided by a small human loudly declaring he wants burgers and chips.

This was very much the second kind of day.

We finally made it to Chuck’s Burger PVC on Phạm Viết Chánh, a place I’ve been low-key following online for over a decade. Since we were staying near Landmark 81, it was an easy Xanh SM ride over. Short, smooth, no complaints. Always a good sign.

The munchkin ordered a cheeseburger with fries without even looking at the menu twice. Confident choice. Respect.

While we were waiting, we were surprised with some complimentary veggie tempura (onion and zucchini) from the boss himself. Light, crispy, dangerously snackable - much appreciated 🙌

Then the burger arrived… and honestly, I blinked and it was gone.
Either he was absolutely starving or the burger really hit the spot, because it disappeared in under five minutes. No talking. No distractions. Full focus.

Final verdict from the in-house expert reviewer: 4.9/5 ⭐️
When I asked about the missing 0.1, he gave me a grin and said:
“Too saucy.”

This was said while sauce was actively dripping everywhere as he kept eating, so take that how you will 😂

All in all: solid burgers, friendly vibes, kid-approved (almost perfect), and definitely worth the short ride if you’re in Bình Thạnh and craving a proper comfort-food fix.

Consistency is its own reward.
Feb 2022 • Couples
The thing about Chuck's Burgers is their consistency in providing a quality product every time I visit. This is brought about by the way the owner trains his staff in good customer service.
Tonight was no exception. The burgers were great and easy to manage while eating them. There's nothing worse than a burger falling apart in your hands while you try to consume the contents.
My wife finds Western sized burgers too much to eat in one serve so she always asks them to cut hers in half which pleases me no end because I get to eat her 2nd half although I would probably pass up on eating a whole 2nd burger. Win win all round. Now that they've opened a 2nd outlet in my district I don't get to eat in the Pasteur Street Diner as much as before but tonight with a function on in D1 we took advantage of the opportunity to eat there again.
Yep still the best American style burger in Saigon in my humble Kiwi/Aussie opinion.

One stop Quick service
Sep 2019 • Solo
I am not a big fan of burgers but soon that will probably change. Chuck's been around for as long as i have stayed at le lai and probably longer exhibiting its staying power in the fast-changing le lai landscape. I was enamoured with the organised custom menu on offer with a standard burger, your choice of toppings, sauce, extra toppings, do go for the mouth watering cheezy fries, and finally your choice of beverage in a bar counter seating arrangement fitting its quick service mantra for the customer on the go. Still i prefer taking my time at the counter, reflecting on my previous visit early this year and how much the business landscape has transformed at Le Lai street. Chuck's has obviously stood the test of time where others failed. Keep the business simple, with tasty juicy burgers, friendly courteous staff at the counter you get your regulars coming for more. A good barometer in the food business today is the amount of delivery riders that show up in the midst of dining hours. That alone gives you the heads up that hey, this place probably got it.

Great food,great service,great value!
Aug 2019 • Family
Enjoyed a family lunch here of burger and chips with a drink. Staff were attentive and serving as soon as we sat down. Was able to select what we wanted in the burger bun from a menu/order card which we ticked off so no chance of misunderstanding or error. Burger was good quality in a burger bun (not a brioche bun!). Chips/fries were sublime skins on, crunchy and well seasoned! All served in a basket. Free refills of drinks which were bottles of Sprite and coke for us. Good value for money at about £10 each.
